t: This is the Association for Cancer Surgery, an organisation for specialists and academics concerned with surgical treatment of malignant cancers. It was founded by Ronald Raven, a British surgeon who lived from 1904 to 1992. Raven matters here because he set the association up, so the body you're standing at owes its existence to a surgeon who cared about this particular field. I don't have more detail about its history or what happens here day to day, so I'll leave it there.
